title: Moonlight latency
hypothesis: Turning off V-Sync in Moonlight lowers total latency by about one frame (~16 ms at 60 FPS) without visible stutter. The performance overlay is used to measure.

results.notes: End-to-end meter (tools/latency/measure.ps1), 1080p, 40 presses, win10 2026-10-27; p95 231.5 ms, min 27.9, 26 valid of 40
End-to-end meter (tools/latency/measure.ps1), 1080p, 40 presses, win10 2026-10-27; p95 122 ms, min 27.6, 34 valid of 40
Moonlight overlay, 60 FPS V-Sync: 57.12 FPS received, network 1 ms, decode 0.32 ms
